title: Evolve NFT
tagline: A NFT based game where each owned NFT gets evolved and has some powers.
description:
A NFT based game where each owned NFT gets evolved and has some powers. As this project still is in a ideation phase I was not able to complete the MVP. Idea from quests - How did we let it come to this? Sitting on thrones of aging treasure, weaving tales of journeys past and beasts slain.

A storm is brewing and it intends to swallow us whole. Can you feel it in the wind?

This world needs us once more. Will you join and fight for it? Or will you watch from afar, singing past travails and flipping for coin?

From the deepest depths,
To the highest peaks,
Forgotten friends and spoils reaped,
how_its_made: The project uses loot contract as an inspiration for the generative NFT based game, it uses solidity for people to mint NFTS. I have used react for creating the frontend where we are showcasing the nft generation and evolution of the characters based on certain aspects. A NFT based game where each owned NFT gets evolved and has some powers.
